headline: Recommended not discontinuing West End Farm trail near 76 Currier Road, and investigating fencing instead.
summary: The group discussed whether to discontinue the West End Farm trail near 76 Currier Road, reviewing the city's criteria for discontinuance. Members voted six in favor, with one abstention, to recommend against discontinuing the trail and to investigate fencing for the parking lot or trail. The group also supported a memorial bench at Winant Park and accepted the forester and trail ranger reports.
decisions: Accepted the City Forester report and Trail Ranger report.
Recommended support for installing a memorial bench at the Winant Park vista, unanimous.
Recommended not moving forward with discontinuance of the West End Farm trail, and investigating fencing for the parking lot and/or trail; six in favor, one abstained.

plain_text:
Concord Trails Subcommittee Meeting Minutes 
 
8/12/2026 Council Chambers Room, City Hall Annex 
Members Present:  
Fran Philippe, Andrew Gould (Secretary), Rik Van Riel, Mark Cheever (Chair), Jason Massa, Nick 
Holmes (Vice Chair), Rebecca Ross and Judy Weatherby (Alternate), 
Staff: Kearsten O’Brien (Senior Planner), Ron Klemarczyk (City Forester), Carl Matson (Trail 
Ranger). 
Other: Kris Tardiff (Conservation Commission). 
Absent: Max Hankard (Alternate), Jeff Lewis (Conservation Commission). 
Guests: Jennifer Goodman, Rene Marro and Beth Marro 
  
1. Meeting called to order at 5:15 PM.  
 
2. Consent Agenda 
 
 a. Approval of 7/8/2026 meeting minutes. Fran Phillipe made the motion. Rik Van 
 Riel seconded the motion. Unanimous. 
 
 b. City Forester Report: accepted 
         Trail Ranger Report: accepted 
• Carl Matson has been trimming the Jim Hill Riverwalk, West End Farm 
Trail and Locke Road trails.  
• Knowlton Woods at Oak Hill- no issues to report 
• MRGT/ sunﬂower trail- no issues to report 
• Riley trails- no issues to report 
 
3. New Business 
 
 a. Jennifer Goodman proposed replacing the bench at the Winant Park viewpoint 
 as a memorial to Annette Nielsen. The bench might read “In Memory of Annette 
 Nielsen.” Rebecca Ross made the motion to support the request for the 
 installation of this new bench at the Winant Park vista. Andrew Gould seconded 
 the motion. Unanimous.  
 
b. Rik Van Riel- Trail Stewards update 
• Vacancy for Mast Yard. 
4. Old Business 
 a. Marsh Loop trail discontinuance discussion: Concerns were mentioned 
 because the trail is relatively close to the marsh. Nick Holmes suggested a 
 possible reroute closer to Ghost Pipe trail. Concerns were brought up about the
safety of hikers using part of Ghost Pipe which typically has faster cyclists using it. The 
Trails Subcommittee will vote at the September meeting on the following options: 
• Discontinuance of the trail 
• A reroute of the trail 
• Leaving the trail as is 
 
  b. Discussion about the proposed discontinuance of the West End Farm trail 
adjacent to 76 Currier Road: The Trails Subcommittee reviewed the “Criteria for 
Discontinuance of a Trail” document. Each bullet item was discussed relative to this section 
of the West End Farm trail. Mark Cheever made the motion to recommend not moving 
forward with the discontinuance of the trail but to consider mitigation strategies by 
investigating fencing opportunities for the parking lot and/or trail. Nick Holmes seconded 
the motion. Six members were in favor and one abstained.  
 
  c. West End Farm Trail Guide Description: did not discuss 
 
5. Other business:  
a. Hikes 
• August 29, 2026, Bob to lead at Oak Hill 
 
6. Staﬀ Updates: None 
 
7. Concord Trails Plan Chapters 4&5 discussion: Did not discuss. 
 
8. Adjourn at 6:44. Fran Phillipe made the motion, Rebecca Ross seconded the motion, 
unanimous.  
 
 
Andrew Gould 
Secretary
